why_no_new_terms: A proposal: „Alles in diesem Dokument ist [V], sofern nicht explizit [K]-Anker zitiert wird" (L17), and „Nichts hieraus gilt als Kanon" (L291). Its own terms are the thread's machinery — the counter-register, the Wartungsfenster, the Stufen, the Warteschlange, the Klick — proposed, not asserted. Its [K] places (Lernarchiv Theta-9, Transitkorridor Delta-7, Komponente 734) are citations of another document's locks, each named once in a chapter line, and earlier readings of those documents left them without pages. A page created from a proposal would say nothing and look like it says something.
